name: Music
description: Plays music from YouTube, SoundCloud, Bandcamp and other links in voice channels. Type music::play <link or search> in a channel it can read, or use its panel; it joins your call with its own encrypted audio.
author: Chriscord
channels: Pick the voice channels it may play in. It doesn't need text channels: its commands and announcements go end-to-end encrypted between members' apps and the plugin. Only if you turn on text commands (!play typed as a chat message) does it need to read a text channel — and then the server's signed member list has to let it.

commands.name: play
commands.description: Join your voice channel and play a link, or the top YouTube result — or queue it

args.name: query
args.description: A link (YouTube, SoundCloud, Bandcamp, a playlist…) or words to search for

commands.name: search
commands.description: The top 10 YouTube results, to pick from

commands.name: pick
commands.description: Play one of your search results

commands.name: queue
commands.description: What's playing and what's next (just for you)

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Take a track out of the queue

commands.name: clear
commands.description: Empty the queue (the current track keeps playing)

commands.name: stop
commands.description: Stop playing and empty the queue
